work.text: Kamisaka Sekka made preparatory drawings for his Flowers of a Hundred Worlds series on tracing paper with ink and color. The freehand sketches are much looser than the finished, printed compositions.

source.author: Cleveland Museum of Art

moment.text: Paintings of the early Rinpa artists were anthologized in small paperback booklets such as the Korin Gafu (The Korin Picture Album) by Nakamura Hochu
moment.lead: Rinpa had long travelled in printed books:

matters.text: In some cases, Raijin is portrayed with three fingers which are said to represent the past, present and future.
